text:
Question: Will I lose my current plan benefits if I port into NovaTel?

Answer: No — once porting completes, you select a NovaTel plan of your choice; your old operator's plan does not carry over. Your number, however, remains unchanged, and any unused balance with the previous operator is non-transferable.

Topic: Number Portability (MNP)
title: Will I lose my current plan benefits if I port into NovaTel?
